question: ________ scheme was announced based on the five pillars to overcome difficulties caused due to COVID-19 in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan** (Self-Reliant India Campaign) was announced by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in May 2020 to help overcome the economic difficulties caused by the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• The scheme was designed to make India self-reliant and focused on five key pillars:
 
 
• **Economy**
 
• **Infrastructure**
 
• **System**
 
• **Vibrant Demography**
